title: D2C & E-commerce
headline: AI for shops and online brands
summary: Sell on WhatsApp, answer buyers instantly, and win back the carts people abandon.
bullets: Customers order straight from WhatsApp
Instant answers on size, stock and delivery
Abandoned carts chased automatically
lead: Most online shops lose sales in the same two places: nobody answers the question fast enough, and the cart gets abandoned. Both are fixable without hiring anyone.
meta: For online shops and D2C brands
body_md:
## Where the money is going

**Nobody replies fast enough.** A buyer asks whether something is in stock, or which size to take, and gets an answer four hours later. By then they have bought it elsewhere. A bot that knows your catalogue answers in seconds, all night, in Hindi or English.

**Carts get abandoned and stay abandoned.** A reminder on WhatsApp an hour later, a nudge the next day, and a small discount on the third day recovers a meaningful share of them. It runs by itself once it is set up.

**Reviews never get asked for.** A message five days after delivery, asking for a photo and a line, quietly builds the social proof that sells the next order.

## Buying inside WhatsApp

For a lot of Indian buyers, WhatsApp is the internet. We build the whole thing there: browse, ask, order, pay by UPI, track the parcel, and reorder in one tap. It usually converts better than the website does.

## What it costs

A full site with payments is live in 48 hours. Most brands start with either that or a WhatsApp ordering bot, and add the other once the first is earning. Both are quoted as one fixed price after a short call.

faq.q: Will it integrate with Shopify or WooCommerce?
faq.a: Yes, both are routine, along with Magento and custom carts. We connect over their APIs, so order status, catalogue, and customer data stay in your store as the single source of truth.

faq.q: What's the fastest win for a D2C brand?
faq.a: Usually a WhatsApp order-status and support bot. It absorbs the “where is my order” volume that dominates D2C support and can go live in about a week. COD confirmation and abandoned-cart recovery flows are close behind.

faq.q: Can it handle returns and COD confirmation?
faq.a: Yes. Return initiation, pickup scheduling, and COD confirmation are standard WhatsApp flows for us, and they hand off to a human the moment a case gets unusual.

faq.q: How do you handle festive-season traffic spikes?
faq.a: The systems run serverless and scale with load rather than on fixed capacity, so a Diwali spike doesn't need re-architecting. We load-test ahead of peak season if you tell us the numbers you're expecting.

seo.title: AI for D2C & E-commerce Brands India | Voltair Tech
seo.description: Storefronts, WhatsApp order bots, Razorpay/UPI checkout and AI product search for D2C brands. Built in Mumbai, live fast.

title: Healthcare & Clinics
headline: AI for clinics and hospitals
summary: Bookings and reminders handled automatically, and safe answers from your own protocols only.
bullets: Bookings and reminders run themselves
Answers only from material you approved
Patient data stays in India and stays private
lead: Your front desk spends most of the day on the phone booking appointments and repeating the same instructions. That work can run itself, safely, without anyone being given medical advice by a computer.
meta: For clinics, hospitals and diagnostic centres
body_md:
## Booking and reminders

Patients book, confirm and reschedule on WhatsApp, at whatever hour suits them. Reminders go out the day before, which is the single cheapest way to cut no shows. Your desk stops being a call centre and goes back to looking after the person standing in front of them.

If your practice management or records system has a connection available, we sync both ways so nothing gets double booked.

## Answering questions safely

The assistant answers only from documents your doctors have approved: preparation instructions, timings, what to bring, what happens afterwards, your policies. Every answer shows which document it came from.

**It does not give medical advice.** Anything clinical goes to your staff. We scope it that way deliberately, because in healthcare a confident wrong answer is a liability.

## Patient data

It stays in a database you control, hosted in India. Access is logged. It is never used to train anybody's model.

## Languages

Hindi, Marathi and English on the same number, replying in whichever the patient used.

faq.q: Is patient data safe with an AI system?
faq.a: Patient data stays in a database you control, hosted in India, and it is never used to train a model. Access is logged, and the assistant only answers from clinical documents you have approved.

faq.q: Can it book and reschedule appointments in our existing system?
faq.a: Yes, wherever your practice-management or patient records system system exposes an API. We sync slots both ways so the bot can't double-book, and we confirm the integration during scoping before you commit.

faq.q: Will the AI give medical advice?
faq.a: No. We scope these assistants to logistics and to answering from your own approved material, appointments, preparation instructions, timings, and policies. Anything clinical is routed to your staff.

faq.q: Does it work for patients who don't speak English?
faq.a: Yes. Hindi, Marathi, and English run on the same WhatsApp number or phone line, with the assistant matching whichever language the patient uses.

Reading identity documents, checking them against the form, spotting the mismatches, and flagging the cases that need a human. What took a day of somebody's attention becomes minutes, and the exceptions get the attention instead.

## Support that knows your rules

Your team answers questions about charges, eligibility and process all day. An assistant trained on your actual policy documents answers those in seconds and shows the clause it came from, so nobody has to trust it blindly.

## Built for the audit

Every answer traceable to a source. Every automated decision logged with what it saw and what it did. Clear limits on what the software may decide alone and what needs a person to sign off. Auditors ask these questions, so we build for them from the start rather than retrofitting.

## Your data

Stays in your own database, in India, and is never used to train anybody's model.

faq.q: Can AI make lending or underwriting decisions?
faq.a: We build systems that gather, verify, and summarise for a human decision-maker, keeping an audit trail of what informed each recommendation. Fully automated adverse decisions are a policy call for your risk and compliance teams, not something we ship by default.

faq.q: Which payment and data providers do you integrate?
faq.a: Razorpay and Stripe are routine, along with account-aggregator, KYC, and bureau APIs. If a provider has documented APIs we can connect it, and we confirm each one during scoping.

faq.q: What's the most common first build in this sector?

faq.a: We build screening that ranks against criteria you define and shows its reasoning for each candidate, so a recruiter can audit and override it. It's a shortlisting aid for a human decision, not an automatic reject machine.

faq.q: What else does it do beyond screening?
faq.a: Candidate Q&A about the role and the process, interview scheduling, and search across your résumé bank so past applicants surface for new roles instead of being lost.

faq.q: Where does candidate data live, and how long is it kept?
faq.a: In a database you control, with retention and deletion rules we agree during scoping, which matters under the DPDP Act, since candidate data is personal data.

faq.q: Does it integrate with our ATS?
faq.a: Wherever the ATS has an API, yes. Where it doesn't, we can work from exports, or build the workflow standalone and sync the outcome back.
